name: Analytic manifold
description: A manifold equipped with an atlas whose transition maps are real-analytic (C^omega), so local coordinate changes are given by convergent power series; this is the natural category for Lie groups, whose multiplication and inversion are analytic.

name: Lie's third theorem (existence)
description: Every finite-dimensional real Lie algebra is the Lie algebra of some Lie group, and there is a unique simply connected Lie group realizing it, so the Lie functor is essentially surjective onto finite-dimensional Lie algebras.

name: Naturality of exp: Ad(exp X) = exp(ad X)
description: For a Lie group G with Lie algebra g, the adjoint representation satisfies Ad(exp X) = exp(ad X) for all X in g, expressing that exp intertwines ad on g with Ad on G.

name: Canonical coordinates of the first and second kind
description: Local coordinate systems near the identity of a Lie group: first kind sends (x_1,...,x_n) to exp(sum x_i X_i) for a basis {X_i} of g, and second kind to the ordered product exp(x_1 X_1)...exp(x_n X_n), both analytic charts since d(exp)_0 = id.

name: Taylor expansion of the product map
description: Recovers the Lie bracket and higher structure of a Lie group from the Taylor expansion of the multiplication map mu(x,y) = x + y + (1/2)[x,y] + ... in canonical coordinates, whose quadratic antisymmetric term is the bracket and whose iteration yields the BCH series.

name: Symmetrization map S(g) -> U(g)
description: The canonical g-module linear isomorphism of the symmetric algebra S(g) onto the universal enveloping algebra U(g) sending X_1...X_n to (1/n!) sum over Sn of X_{sigma(1)}...X_{sigma(n)}, splitting the PBW filtration.

name: Infinitesimal (central) character
description: The algebra homomorphism chi: Z(U(g)) -> C by which the center of the universal enveloping algebra acts as scalars on an irreducible or highest-weight g-module, given for highest weight lambda via the Harish-Chandra isomorphism by evaluation at lambda + rho.
